gcp.storage.multi.class_a.note: Class A operations (writes) on Standard storage in a multi-region bucket, flat namespace. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.

gcp.storage.multi.class_b.note: Class B operations (reads) on Standard storage in a multi-region bucket, flat namespace. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.

gcp.storage.multi.standard.note: Standard storage in a multi-region bucket (US, EU, ASIA), the bucket Container Registry keeps images in. Read from the pricing page's region table on 2026-09-25; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.
